bullets.text: A family in Thirumazhisai waited two and a half hours for last rites because of a crematorium power outage, so the office should check local infrastructure.
A young man was jailed in Ponneri for sexually assaulting a toddler, so the office should monitor the police investigation and child support.
Velachery residents still face floods despite drainage work, so the office should review the remaining stormwater network gaps.
Commuters in Adambakkam are suffering because trains do not stop there, so the office should coordinate with railway authorities to fix the schedule.
Thousands of Avadi streetlights remain non-functional despite a large maintenance contract, so the office must audit the contractor immediately.
Auto drivers protested against the Vetri Payanam scheme, so the office should review the policy impact on their livelihoods.
A fake doctor was arrested in Avadi for a job scam worth crores, so the office should watch for similar fraudulent schemes.
Vultr plans to build a 20 MW supercluster in Chennai, so the office should facilitate necessary clearances for this cloud expansion.
Tata Communications is investing four thousand crore rupees for an AI super highway, so the office should support this digital infrastructure.
The Tamil Nadu government will soon launch the e-Sevakai 2.0 project for faster services, so the office should track the rollout progress.

stories.title: 2.5-hour wait for family with body as crematorium suffers power trouble in Thirumazhisai
takeaways: A grieving family waited two and a half hours for last rites due to power failure in Thirumazhisai crematorium.
The incident highlights civic infrastructure failures in Thiruvallur district that require immediate administrative intervention.

takeaways: Over 3000 Avadi streetlights remain non-functional despite a Rs 22-crore maintenance contract.
The failure creates severe safety hazards for residents navigating waterlogged roads.
